request.style: English, soft jazz ballad, smooth female vocal, piano trio with upright bass and brushes, muted trumpet, tenor sax solo, intimate late-evening feel, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The supper on the table and the lamps were burning low
He knelt down with a basin, it was time for him to go
He washed the dust from every foot, the doubter and the proud
And then he spoke so gently, though his heart was crying loud

[Chorus]
A new commandment I give you: love one another
As I have loved you, so you must love one another
By this everyone will know that you are my disciples
If you have love for one another

[Verse]
Not just the easy neighbors, not just the ones we choose
Not just when love is simple and there's nothing much to lose
The towel and the basin, the bread passed hand to hand
This is the way he loved us, this is his command

[Chorus]
A new commandment I give you: love one another
As I have loved you, so you must love one another
By this everyone will know that you are my disciples
If you have love for one another

[Outro]
Love one another
As I have loved you
